text: Talk to Ellamaria east of Varrock Castle.
dialogue: I would be happy to help someone who is so in touch with the people.

text: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.
dialogue: Queen Ellamaria has sent me to seek your guidance.
I have returned to you with the Ring of Charos.
Can I retake the diplomacy test?

text: Talk to Elstan north west of Draynor Village.
dialogue: Do you have any delphinium seeds to spare?
[Charm] That is why I have come to an expert for advice.
[Charm] Not just AN expert, Elstan - they say you are THE expert.
[Charm] Oh no, I love listening to gardening stories...
[Charm] Millions? Ah, just what I wanted to hear...
Okay, I'll grow you some marigolds.

text: Plant a marigold near to Elstan.
Talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys.
dialogue: Do you have any orchid seeds to spare?
[Charm] If you tell me your problems, I may be able to help you.
[Charm] Yes, I was wondering about that.
[Charm] Times must be very hard for you.
[Charm] Whatever you've done, I'm sure you had just cause.
[Charm] And what is the nature of this fee that you pay?
[Charm] If not yours, then whose blood are you offering?
[Charm] How can you deal with so much guilt?
That's a deal - I'll grow a patch of onions for you.

text: Plant onions in a patch near Lyra. Plant in both for the best chance of one not dying.
Talk to Kragen northeast of Ardougne.
dialogue: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
[Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
[Charm] I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
[Charm] So what ails you, my friend?
[Charm] Well, is there anything I can do for you?
[Charm] So what can I do for you?
That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.

text: Plant cabbage seeds in the patches near Kragen. Plant in both to be safe.
Talk to Dantaera north of Catherby.
dialogue: Do you know how I could grow a White Tree?
[Charm] I think that there is something that you are not telling me.
[Charm] A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself.
[Charm] Unless you allow me to do this she will die anyway.

text: Use secateurs on the white tree on top of Ice Mountain.
Use the shoot on a plant pot.
Water the white tree shoot.
Talk to Brother Althric in the Edgeville Monastery.
dialogue: [Charm] These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen.

text: Use the Ring of charos(a) on the well in Edgeville.
Take some seeds from the white roses.
Take some seeds from the pink roses.
Take some seeds from the red roses.
Use a fishing rod on the well in Edgeville to retrieve the ring of charos. This can take a few attempts.
Talk to Bernald in Burthorpe.
dialogue: [Charm] But it is the only way that these vines will be cured.
I accept the deal.

text: Use plant cure on Bernald's grapevines.
Talk to Alain in Taverley with your ring of charos UNEQUIPPED.
dialogue: I need to ask you about strong plant cures.

text: Use a hammer on some essence.
Use a pestle and mortar on the essence shards.
Use the rune dust on some plant cure.
Use the enhanced plant cure on Bernald's grapevines.
Talk to Bernald for his seeds.
Harvest marigolds from the Falador Allotment patches. If yours died, you'll need to grow some more there.
Give Elstan a marigold for his seeds.
dialogue: I have those marigolds for you.

text: Talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys again for her seeds.
dialogue: Okay, I've grown those onions like you asked.

text: Talk to Kragen northeast of Ardougne for his seeds.
dialogue: Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.

text: Wait for your onions to finish growing. If they died you'll need to plant more in Lyra's patches.
Wait for your cabbages to finish growing. If they died you'll need to plant more in Kragen's patches.
Fill the plantpots in Ellamaria's garden with compost.
Fill the plantpots in Ellamaria's garden with compost.
Plant the pink orchids in the marked plantpot.
Plant the yellow orchids in the marked plantpot.
Plant the vine seeds.
Plant snowdrops in the east patch.
Plant the white tree.
Plant the delphinum seeds.
Plant the rose seeds.
Plant the rose seeds.
Plant the rose seeds.
Talk to Ellamaria for a trolley.
dialogue: How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?

text: Use a trolley on the king statue outside Lumbridge Castle.
Push the trolley across the River Lum, then to the marked plinth in the garden. Right-click 'place' the statue when it's next to the plinth.
Use the trolley on the statue of Saradomin in Falador.
Push the trolley out of Falador, then to the marked plinth in the garden. Right-click 'place' the statue when it's next to the plinth.
Talk to Ellamaria once everything's finished growing.
Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle, watch the cutscene, then finish the dialog with Ellamaria to finish the quest!
dialogue: Ask King Roald to follow me.
[Charm] Of course, your majesty - please forgive me.
[Charm] The Queen asked me to bring you.
Would you like to follow me for a minute?
